bio.text: Katie Hobbs is the Democratic governor of Arizona and a candidate for re-election in 2026; she was elected governor in 2022.

According to the governor's office, she was born and raised in Arizona, put herself through college at Northern Arizona University and Arizona State University, and began her career as a social worker before helping run a large domestic violence shelter.
She was elected to the Arizona House in 2010 and served four terms in the state Legislature, two of them as Senate Minority Leader.
Hobbs was elected Arizona Secretary of State in 2018.
